findings.title: Conversion Rate Decline Week-over-Week
findings.claim: Conversion rate decreased from 25.60% (week of 2026-05-18) to 23.67% (week of 2026-05-25), a -7.5% decline.
coverage_notes: Analysis period: 119 traffic records (dead sensor days excluded)
Previous period: 119 traffic records (dead sensor days excluded)
assumptions: Each unique transaction_id represents one customer visit
Dead sensor days correctly identified in traffic data
Timezone conversion to Asia/Riyadh applied consistently

findings.title: Labour Cost Ratio Increase
findings.claim: Labour cost as percentage of revenue increased from 14.6% (week of 2026-05-18) to 11.1% (week of 2026-05-25), an increase of -3.5 percentage points.
coverage_notes: Analysis period: 39 staff records, 3067 POS records
Previous period: 42 staff records, 2505 POS records
assumptions: Labour cost calculated from staff shift records with computed_duration_hours
Revenue calculated as sum of line_total_sar (includes discounts and refunds)
All staff records have valid labour_cost_sar values

findings.title: Known Waste Cost Increase
findings.claim: Known waste cost increased from 1270.30 SAR (week of 2026-05-18) to 1029.00 SAR (week of 2026-05-25), an increase of -241.30 SAR. 6 items had measurable waste in the analysis week.
coverage_notes: Analysis period: 6 inventory records, 6 with measurable waste
Previous period: 6 inventory records, 6 with measurable waste
Only known_waste_cost_sar included; unknown waste values excluded per requirements
assumptions: known_waste_cost_sar accurately reflects waste cost for each SKU
Inventory counts are weekly snapshots (Sunday counts per schema)
Unit cost and waste calculations are deterministic
